description: This file defines the Basket entity within the application core of the eShopOnWeb project. It manages the basket's items, handles adding and removing items, and maintains the buyer's ID.

classes.name: Basket
classes.description: Represents a shopping basket with items, providing methods to add, remove, and manage items and buyer information.

methods.name: Basket
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a new Basket with the specified buyer ID.

methods.name: AddItem
methods.description: Adds an item to the basket or updates quantity if item already exists.

methods.name: RemoveEmptyItems
methods.description: Removes any items from the basket with zero quantity.

methods.name: SetNewBuyerId
methods.description: Updates the buyer ID associated with the basket.
